verdict.rationale: Zapier's integration docs show that apps expose triggers (polling and webhook) alongside actions, and community users describe building 'if this then that' Zaps with multiple IFs and THENs. That supports event-triggered workflows as a core product capability. However, the evidence is mostly developer-facing or anecdotal rather than end-user trigger documentation. Missing for 10: first-party ops-user docs on configuring Zap triggers, explicit evidence for the named event types (new record, message, email, form submission), and hands-on corroboration of trigger reliability or latency.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: design triggers and actions for your product
Zapier allows more simultaneous IFs & THENs
